title: Describe
subtitle: 「描述／描繪／說明／敘述」，要先分清是在呈現外觀或情況、刻畫人物、解釋原因、概述重點，還是詳細交代事件。
description: 「描述／描繪／說明／敘述」，要先分清是在呈現外觀或情況、刻畫人物、解釋原因、概述重點，還是詳細交代事件。

words.example: The painting depicts daily life in the old harbour.
words.exampleZh: 這幅畫描繪舊港口的日常生活。

exercises.original: The painting describes daily life in the old harbour.
exercises.zh: 這幅畫描繪舊港口的日常生活。
exercises.upgrade: The painting depicts daily life in the old harbour.

options.explanation: painting 透過視覺呈現 daily life，depict 是最自然的藝術用語。
畫作未必解釋原因或機制。
畫作不是逐項列出生活元素。
不涉及詞義或概念邊界。
原句沒有評價生活好壞。

exercises.original: The documentary describes conditions in the refugee camp.
exercises.zh: 紀錄片呈現難民營的情況。
exercises.upgrade: The documentary depicts conditions in the refugee camp.

options.explanation: documentary 可透過影像和敘事呈現 conditions。
只列項不足以呈現整體情況。
原句不一定作價值判斷。
documentary 可以詳盡呈現，不只是摘要。

exercises.original: The novel describes village life in the 1950s.
exercises.zh: 小說描寫五十年代的鄉村生活。
exercises.upgrade: The novel depicts village life in the 1950s.

options.explanation: 文學作品呈現一種生活景象，depict 很自然。

words.example: The novel portrays the main character as deeply conflicted.
words.exampleZh: 小說把主角刻畫成內心十分矛盾的人。

exercises.original: The film describes the politician as ambitious but insecure.
exercises.zh: 電影把這名政治人物刻畫成有野心但欠安全感。
exercises.upgrade: The film portrays the politician as ambitious but insecure.

options.explanation: portray someone as + adjective 是標準人物形象刻畫結構。
原句只呈現形象，不必解釋原因。

exercises.original: The novel describes the father as distant and controlling.
exercises.zh: 小說把父親刻畫成冷淡而控制慾強。
exercises.upgrade: The novel portrays the father as distant and controlling.

options.explanation: as distant and controlling 正是 portrayal 結構。
這裡主要是角色塑造，不是正式評估。

exercises.original: The media report described the neighbourhood as unsafe.
exercises.zh: 媒體報道把該社區描繪成不安全。
exercises.upgrade: The media report portrayed the neighbourhood as unsafe.

options.explanation: portrayed as unsafe 表示以某種方式呈現社區形象。

words.example: The guide explains how the booking system works.
words.exampleZh: 指南解釋預約系統如何運作。

exercises.original: The guide describes how the booking system works.
exercises.zh: 指南解釋預約系統如何運作。
exercises.upgrade: The guide explains how the booking system works.

options.explanation: how the system works 明確要求機制說明。
可視覺呈現，但不如 explain 直接說明運作。
通常用於人物／情境形象。
只列步驟未必令讀者理解機制。

exercises.original: The teacher described why the experiment failed.
exercises.zh: 老師解釋實驗為甚麼失敗。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher explained why the experiment failed.

options.explanation: why 直接要求原因解釋。
列出事實未必建立因果。

exercises.original: The article describes how inflation affects household spending.
exercises.zh: 文章解釋通脹如何影響家庭開支。
exercises.upgrade: The article explains how inflation affects household spending.

options.explanation: how X affects Y 是因果／機制說明。
可描繪現象，但不如 explain 表達因果。
定義 inflation 不等於解釋影響。
只列項不等於解釋關係。

words.example: The report outlines the main causes of the delay.
words.exampleZh: 報告概述延誤的主要原因。

exercises.original: The report briefly describes the main causes of the delay.
exercises.zh: 報告簡述延誤的主要原因。
exercises.upgrade: The report briefly outlines the main causes of the delay.

options.explanation: briefly + main causes 表示只交代主要重點。
detail 反而表示提供很多具體細節，和 briefly 不符。

exercises.original: The speaker described the plan in broad terms.
exercises.zh: 講者概述了計劃的大方向。
exercises.upgrade: The speaker outlined the plan in broad terms.

options.explanation: in broad terms 是 outline 的直接線索。

exercises.original: The introduction describes the structure of the report.
exercises.zh: 引言概述報告結構。
exercises.upgrade: The introduction outlines the structure of the report.

options.explanation: introduction 常簡要交代報告結構。

words.example: The report characterises the market as highly competitive.
words.exampleZh: 報告把市場描述為競爭非常激烈。

exercises.original: The report describes the market as highly competitive.
exercises.zh: 報告把市場描述為競爭非常激烈。
exercises.upgrade: The report characterises the market as highly competitive.

options.explanation: characterise X as Y 是描述整體特徵的標準結構。

exercises.original: Researchers described the behaviour as highly adaptive.
exercises.zh: 研究人員把這種行為描述為高度適應性。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers characterised the behaviour as highly adaptive.

options.explanation: research context + as adjective 是典型正式用法。

exercises.original: The period is often described by rapid technological change.
exercises.zh: 這個時期常以快速科技轉變為特徵。
exercises.upgrade: The period is often characterised by rapid technological change.

options.explanation: characterised by 是描述時期典型特徵的固定搭配。
句法和搭配都不如 characterised by。

words.example: The chart illustrates how demand changed over time.
words.exampleZh: 圖表顯示需求如何隨時間改變。

exercises.original: The chart describes how demand changed over time.
exercises.zh: 圖表顯示需求如何隨時間改變。
exercises.upgrade: The chart illustrates how demand changed over time.

options.explanation: chart 用視覺方式清楚展示變化，illustrate 最自然。

exercises.original: This example describes the difference between correlation and causation.
exercises.zh: 這個例子說明相關與因果的差別。
exercises.upgrade: This example illustrates the difference between correlation and causation.

options.explanation: example + difference 是 illustrate 的典型搭配。
定義兩詞不等於用例子顯示差異。

exercises.original: The case study describes the risks of poor planning.
exercises.zh: 個案研究說明規劃不足的風險。
exercises.upgrade: The case study illustrates the risks of poor planning.

options.explanation: case study 作為具體例子展示風險。
只是列出不如 case study 的示範作用。

words.example: The report presents a clear picture of changing consumer habits.
words.exampleZh: 報告清楚呈現消費習慣的變化。

exercises.original: The report describes a clear picture of changing consumer habits.
exercises.zh: 報告清楚呈現消費習慣的變化。
exercises.upgrade: The report presents a clear picture of changing consumer habits.

options.explanation: report presents a picture of... 是正式呈現資訊的自然搭配。

exercises.original: The researchers described their findings in three sections.
exercises.zh: 研究人員分三部分呈現研究結果。
exercises.upgrade: The researchers presented their findings in three sections.

options.explanation: findings + organised sections 是正式呈現。
可能有列表，但原句是完整呈現 findings。
研究結果不是藝術描繪。
不表示向讀者陳述結果。

exercises.original: The paper describes evidence from several studies.
exercises.zh: 論文呈現來自多項研究的證據。
exercises.upgrade: The paper presents evidence from several studies.

options.explanation: academic paper 可正式 present evidence。

words.example: The document details the steps required to apply.
words.exampleZh: 文件詳細說明申請所需步驟。

exercises.original: The document describes every step required to apply.
exercises.zh: 文件詳細說明申請所需每個步驟。
exercises.upgrade: The document details every step required to apply.

options.explanation: every step 明確要求完整細節。
只概述主要步驟，細節不足。

exercises.original: The report describes the changes made to the system in full.
exercises.zh: 報告完整詳述系統所作改動。
exercises.upgrade: The report details the changes made to the system.

options.explanation: in full 表示具體逐項說明。
需要例子／圖示，不等於完整列出改動。

exercises.original: The contract describes the responsibilities of each party in detail.
exercises.zh: 合約詳細列明各方責任。
exercises.upgrade: The contract details the responsibilities of each party.

options.explanation: contract + responsibilities + in detail 是非常自然的 formal use。

words.example: The policy sets out the conditions for receiving support.
words.exampleZh: 政策列明獲得支援的條件。

exercises.original: The policy describes the conditions for receiving support.
exercises.zh: 政策列明獲得支援的條件。
exercises.upgrade: The policy sets out the conditions for receiving support.

options.explanation: policy + conditions 是英式正式文件中很典型的 set out。
條件需清楚列明，不是簡單提及。
政策條件需要清晰、有條理。

exercises.original: The guidance describes the rules that applicants must follow.
exercises.zh: 指引列明申請人必須遵守的規則。
exercises.upgrade: The guidance sets out the rules that applicants must follow.

options.explanation: guidance/rules 是正式列明規則的標準搭配。
定義規則不是同一件事。
可舉例，但不等於列明規則。

exercises.original: The letter describes the reasons for the decision clearly.
exercises.zh: 信件清楚列出作出決定的原因。
exercises.upgrade: The letter clearly sets out the reasons for the decision.

options.explanation: reasons + clearly 表示有條理地陳述。

words.example: The witness gave a detailed account of what happened.
words.exampleZh: 目擊者詳細敘述了事情經過。

exercises.original: The witness described what happened in detail.
exercises.zh: 目擊者詳細敘述了事情經過。
exercises.upgrade: The witness gave a detailed account of what happened.

options.explanation: witness + what happened 是事件敘述的典型語境。
不能完整交代事件經過。
不如 account 表達敘事經過。

exercises.original: She described her experience of the storm to the investigators.
exercises.zh: 她向調查人員敘述自己經歷風暴的情況。
exercises.upgrade: She gave the investigators an account of her experience of the storm.

options.explanation: personal experience + investigators 表示有組織地交代經過。

exercises.original: The traveller described the journey from beginning to end.
exercises.zh: 旅人由頭到尾敘述旅程。
exercises.upgrade: The traveller gave an account of the journey from beginning to end.

options.explanation: beginning to end 明確是按順序敘述經歷。

words.meaning: 喚起；營造出；使人感受到
words.example: The poem evokes a strong sense of isolation.
words.exampleZh: 這首詩營造出強烈的孤獨感。

exercises.original: The poem describes a strong sense of isolation.
exercises.zh: 這首詩營造出強烈孤獨感。
exercises.upgrade: The poem evokes a strong sense of isolation.

options.explanation: poem + sense of isolation 是透過語言喚起感受，而非直接說明。

exercises.original: The music describes the atmosphere of a quiet winter evening.
exercises.zh: 音樂營造出寧靜冬夜的氣氛。
exercises.upgrade: The music evokes the atmosphere of a quiet winter evening.

options.explanation: music 不能字面『描述』細節，但可喚起 atmosphere。

exercises.original: The photograph describes memories of childhood for many viewers.
exercises.zh: 這張照片令很多觀眾想起童年回憶。
exercises.upgrade: The photograph evokes memories of childhood for many viewers.

options.explanation: photograph + memories 是典型 evoke 搭配。

words.example: The interviews paint a vivid picture of life in the neighbourhood.
words.exampleZh: 訪談生動描繪了該社區的生活面貌。

exercises.original: The interviews describe life in the neighbourhood very vividly.
exercises.zh: 訪談非常生動地描繪該社區的生活。
exercises.upgrade: The interviews paint a vivid picture of life in the neighbourhood.

options.explanation: very vividly 是此慣用語的直接線索。
和 vivid detailed impression 不同。

exercises.original: The report describes a bleak future for the industry.
exercises.zh: 報告描繪出該行業黯淡的未來。
exercises.upgrade: The report paints a bleak picture of the industry's future.

options.explanation: bleak picture 是常見比喻搭配，表示生動呈現負面前景。
雖有負面判斷，但這裡重點是整體描繪。

exercises.original: The documentary describes the difficulties faced by migrant workers in vivid detail.
exercises.zh: 紀錄片生動描繪外來工人面對的困難。
exercises.upgrade: The documentary paints a vivid picture of the difficulties faced by migrant workers.

options.explanation: vivid detail + documentary 支持這個生動畫面式表達。
只列困難不等於生動呈現。

words.example: The artist rendered the city skyline in remarkable detail.
words.exampleZh: 藝術家以極細緻方式描繪城市天際線。

exercises.original: The artist described the city skyline in remarkable detail.
exercises.zh: 藝術家以極細緻方式描繪城市天際線。
exercises.upgrade: The artist rendered the city skyline in remarkable detail.

options.explanation: artist + in detail 是正式藝術描繪語境。

exercises.original: The illustrator described the animal's fur with great precision.
exercises.zh: 插畫家非常精細地描繪動物毛皮。
exercises.upgrade: The illustrator rendered the animal's fur with great precision.

options.explanation: illustrator + precision 表示細緻視覺呈現。
outline 只交代大概輪廓，和 great precision 不符。

exercises.original: The novel describes the landscape in unusually delicate language.
exercises.zh: 小說用異常細膩的語言描繪景觀。
exercises.upgrade: The novel renders the landscape in unusually delicate language.

options.explanation: literary + delicate language 支持較藝術化的 render。

falseSynonyms.zh: 命名不等於 describe name 只是指出名稱；describe 要提供特徵、情況或細節。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Naming identifies; describing gives characteristics or details.

falseSynonyms.zh: 列出不等於 describe list 只是逐項列出；describe 通常還要說明每項的特徵或情況。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Listing enumerates; describing explains what something is like.

falseSynonyms.zh: 定義不等於 describe define 是精確說明詞義／概念邊界；describe 可以較靈活地提供特徵。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Defining states meaning or boundaries; describing gives features.

falseSynonyms.zh: explain 和 describe 有重疊，但焦點不同 explain 回答 how/why；describe 主要回答 what something is like / what happened。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Explanation gives causes or mechanisms; description gives features or an account.

falseSynonyms.zh: 摘要不等於完整 describe summarise 只保留主要重點；describe 可以很詳細。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Summarising compresses; describing may include rich detail.

falseSynonyms.zh: 評估不等於 describe evaluate 是判斷質素／價值；describe 本身不要求作價值判斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Evaluation judges quality; description can remain neutral.

falseSynonyms.zh: 提及不等於 describe mention 只是簡短提到；describe 需要更多資訊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Mentioning refers briefly; describing provides detail.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 describe 是動詞；description 是名詞。句子結構不能直接互換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Describe is a verb; description is a noun.
